correctness.rationale: For n=9, exactly 84 concepts imply Ldim<=6. The included verified complete depth-6 tree has 64 distinct three-element witnesses and 63 internal pair queries; every one of its path traces is checked. A fixed five-edge star has all 32 traces. Every six-edge shattered graph would be a forest; the seven possible component-size triples admit explicitly exhibited incompatible three-block orientations, so no six-edge support is shattered. At n<=8 there are <=56 hypotheses; n>=9 inherits the fixed nine-vertex tree.
